crossRefs.note: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.

people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

translations.web: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.
translations.bsb: The fourth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Issachar:
